[Problem]{.card-kicker} **LRU cache** [LC 146 · LRU Cache](https://leetcode.com/problems/lru-cache/){difficulty="Medium"}

We need a map (find a key in $O(1)$) and an order of use in which we can move any element to the front and remove the back in $O(1)$. A doubly linked list does the second; a hash map from key to list node does the first. Python packages exactly this pair as `OrderedDict`.

[Solved in full in @sec-lang-p1-lru.]{.card-link}

:::
